user = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
token = apis.spotify.login(username=user['username'], password=creds['spotify']['password'])

recos = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page)
    if not batch:
        break
    recos.extend(batch)
    page += 1

songs = [apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=r['song_id']) for r in recos]
filtered = [s for s in songs if s['genre'] == target_genre and s['release_date'] >= threshold_date]

playlist = apis.spotify.create_playlist(access_token=token, title=playlist_title)
for s in filtered:
    apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(access_token=token, playlist_id=playlist['playlist_id'], song_id=s['song_id'])

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None, status="success")
